name: @onegrid/wasm
description: Hot-path acceleration seam for oneGrid — one AccelBackend interface over sortIndex / filterMask / groupKey / aggregate / bitmapOp / topK, with a pure-JS reference implementation that delegates to @onegrid/data, a raw-pointer WebAssembly binding (JS-side bump allocator, detached-buffer-safe views), capability detection for WASM / SIMD / threads, and a differential harness that proves the two backends byte-identical.
